hacks.name: Keyboard Visualizer
hacks.description: Display a live piano-keyboard on Push's screen.
hacks.author: federico-pepe

hacks.name: Automation
hacks.description: LFO-style MIDI CC automation sequencer. Draw curves in the web UI, send CC values to Push 3 in real-time so Live can record them as automation.
hacks.author: federico-pepe

hacks.name: Random Preset
hacks.description: Shift+Add loads a random preset, Shift+Swap a random drum rack kit.
hacks.author: itsrave

hacks.name: Audio Loopback (alpha)
hacks.description: Audio for hacks. Sends the audio of hacks to Live over Ableton Link Audio (default) or through a persistent virtual sound card ("Push Hack Virtual Audio"), and routes Link channels into hack inputs, without opening the real hardware device.
hacks.author: federico-pepe

hacks.name: Braids (alpha)
hacks.description: Macro oscillator module based on Mutable Instruments Braids by Emilie Gillet, ported from Schwung DSP. Reads Push 3's own pad MIDI and renders audio through the Audio Loopback virtual card. On-screen MIDI/audio device picker.
hacks.author: federico-pepe

hacks.name: MachineModule (alpha)
hacks.description: Machinedrum-style drum machine for Push 3: 16 synth/sample tracks, sequencer with parameter locks, effects, kits and songs. Plays through the Audio Loopback mixer.
hacks.author: joman66

hacks.name: MonoModule (alpha)
hacks.description: Monomachine-style six-voice synth for Push 3: 22 machines, filter and LFOs, pitched sequencer with parameter locks, POLY mode, arpeggiator, kits and songs. Plays through the Audio Loopback mixer.
hacks.author: joman66

hacks.name: Screensaver
hacks.description: Idle screensaver: after a timeout it takes over the display with animations (Rainbow / Twinkle / Starfield); pads and buttons glow along. Any input wakes it. Configured on-device via push-manager's Shadow UI.
hacks.author: itsrave

hacks.name: Mixxx Mode
hacks.description: DJ with Mixxx on Push 3: two decks on the pads, buttons and encoders, waveforms on the Push screen, Rekordbox USB sticks. Switching to Mixxx mode stops Push3 and Live; hold SETTINGS to go back. Requires push-manager (it drives the screen while Push3 is stopped). Large download (about 170 MB, Mixxx is bundled).
hacks.author: itsrave

hacks.name: Stacks
hacks.description: Chord-progression tool: write, voice and play chord progressions into Live from Push's screen, pads and buttons.
hacks.author: rgeissen

hacks.name: Arrangement
hacks.description: Shows the open Live Set's arrangement on the Push 3 screen: zoom, scroll, loop and punch, locators, play-start anchor. Touch a knob to see what it does. Toggle with Shift+Session. Needs the PushHack Remote Script enabled once in Live.
hacks.author: federico-pepe

hacks.name: Net MIDI
hacks.description: The Push's MIDI on the network as Apple MIDI (RTP-MIDI): an iPad, iPhone or Mac sees the Push as a network MIDI peer, with one port for Live and routes for other hacks' ports.
hacks.author: rgeissen

hacks.name: ConvoluteCreator
hacks.description: Pick a sample on the Push and make a Convolution Reverb preset that uses it as the impulse response. Preview audio plays through the Audio Loopback mixer.
hacks.author: joman66

hacks.name: Airwindows
hacks.description: Effect chain of up to 8 Airwindows effects (510 effects in 22 categories). Audio from a Live track comes in over Ableton Link Audio, runs through the chain and goes back to Live. Edit it on Push's screen and encoders or in the web UI.
hacks.author: joman66

hacks.name: Sample Edit
hacks.description: Offline sampler and editor: record, trim, chop, process and export to Simpler, Sampler or Drum Rack. Preview audio and the stereo input use Audio Loopback in Link mode.
hacks.author: joman66
